title: Clock-Bit Writing Step
statement: Let $b_s,\alpha,x,$ and $c$ be finite Boolean strings, let $b$ be a bit, and let $p$ be a natural number with $p<|\langle\langle b_s,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle|$. When the prefix parser is in the fourth clock phase for $b$, with input head at position $p+1$, clock string $c$, and empty output, one step advances the input head to position $p+2$, appends $b$ to the clock string, returns to the first clock phase, and leaves the output empty.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $p$ strictly less than $|\langle\langle b_s,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle|$
replaced:
In the fourth phase of a clock bit $b$, one step of the prefix parser advances
the input head one cell and appends the single bit $b$ to the clock string
stored on its work tape, returning to the first clock phase with no output.
